label: MRtrix3 labelconvert
description:
Convert a connectome node image from one lookup table to another
Typical usage is to convert a parcellation image provided by some other software, based on the lookup table provided by that software, to conform to a new lookup table, particularly one where the node indices increment from 1, in preparation for connectome construction; examples of such target lookup table files are provided in share//mrtrix3//labelconvert//, but can be created by the user to provide the desired node set // ordering // colours.
Convert a Desikan-Killiany parcellation image as provided by FreeSurfer to have nodes incrementing from 1: $ labelconvert aparc+aseg.mgz FreeSurferColorLUT.txt mrtrix3//share//mrtrix3//labelconvert//fs_default.txt nodes.mif  Paths to the files in the example above would need to be revised according to their locations on the user's system.

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: lut_in
input_slots.description: the connectome lookup table corresponding to the input image

input_slots.label: lut_out
input_slots.description: the target connectome lookup table for the output image

input_slots.label: spine
input_slots.description: provide a manually-defined segmentation of the base of the spine where the streamlines terminate, so that this can become a node in the connection matrix.
